insights.mega: IMF GFSR: 22% of global banking assets in weak banks under AI-crash + bond-yield spike stress (up from 18%), Asian banks hardest hit excluding China. Mega-scale risks amplify UBI necessity for systemic stability.
insights.flow: Japan regional deposit flow: Tohoku banks (Procrea Holdings, Bank of Iwate, Akita Bank) start merger talks for ¥13.3tn group by 2028 amid rate-driven deposit competition and demographics; BOJ Sept deposits +1.6% y/y. Capital flows shift toward consolidated entities.
insights.gap: Inequality gap: Japan relative child poverty ~11%, single-parent rates high; AI wealth concentration fuels UBI/abundance debates (Musk: beyond UBI to high income era). Persistent regional and generational gaps require targeted flows.
insights.pulse: Hourly pulse 1474 registers mid-day acceleration in regional consolidation signals and AI-risk narratives, sustaining cycle 31 momentum without domain acquisition.
insights.ethics: Ethics (insolvency): Stress scenarios highlight insolvency risks for weaker SIFIs and regionals; ethical need for redistribution and UBI-dignity to protect against deposit shifts and AI shocks. Dignity-preserving transfers over pure market outcomes.
insights.heal: Heal: Regional consolidation builds scale and resilience; pair with targeted UBI/cash transfers to heal inequality and buffer job/automation risks. Healing pathways via on-chain UBI pilots.
insights.return: Return: Pulse confirms stable live origin https://ubi-chain.github.io; custom www.ietfubi.com remains unregistered, ubi-chain.com NXDOMAIN. No domain purchases; focus returns to content and on-chain flow integrity.

news.title: IMF stress test: AI boom fuels more weak banks in doomsday scenario
news.summary: IMF Global Financial Stability Report (Oct 2026): under AI crash + soaring yields + slowdown, 22% of global banking assets in 110 weak lenders (core capital <7%), up from 18%. Asian banks (ex-China) most affected.

news.title: UBI discussions intensify amid AI abundance visions and inequality
news.summary: Elon Musk on AI enabling high-income era beyond UBI; NYT and others highlight pilot programs for AI job risks. Japan analyses note UBI alone insufficient without capital/redistribution paths; relative poverty persists.
